// ScyllaDB Schema for Payment Processor
// Keyspace creation
CREATE KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS payment_keyspace WITH replication = {
  'class': 'SimpleStrategy',
  'replication_factor': 3
};

// Users table: Partition by email, clustering by created_at
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payment_keyspace.users (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  email TEXT,
  enterprise BOOLEAN,
  created_at TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP,
  jwt_token TEXT,
  keycloak_id TEXT
) WITH default_time_to_live = 0
  AND compaction = {'class': 'LeveledCompactionStrategy'}
  AND clustering_order_by = {'created_at': 'DESC'};

// Transactions table: Partition by user_id, clustering by timestamp
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payment_keyspace.transactions (
  user_id UUID,
  transaction_id UUID,
  timestamp TIMESTAMP,
  amount DECIMAL,
  currency TEXT,
  card_token_hash TEXT,
  iso8583_message BLOB,
  status TEXT,  // 'pending', 'processed', 'failed'
  erstegroup_response TEXT,
  fraud_score FLOAT,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, timestamp)
) WITH default_time_to_live = 31536000  // 1 year
  AND compaction = {'class': 'TimeWindowCompactionStrategy', 'compaction_window_size': 3600, 'compaction_window_unit': 'SECONDS'};

// Payouts table: Partition by user_id, clustering by payout_id
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payment_keyspace.payouts (
  user_id UUID,
  payout_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  timestamp TIMESTAMP,
  amount DECIMAL,
  currency TEXT,
  ach_file TEXT,  // NACHA string
  sepa_xml TEXT,
  status TEXT,
  apple_pay_token TEXT,
  processed_at TIMESTAMP
) WITH default_time_to_live = 0
  AND compaction = {'class': 'LeveledCompactionStrategy'};

// Fraud logs: Partition by timestamp, clustering by user_id
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payment_keyspace.fraud_logs (
  timestamp TIMESTAMP,
  user_id UUID,
  transaction_id UUID,
  anomaly_score FLOAT,
  details TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (timestamp, user_id)
) WITH default_time_to_live = 2592000  // 30 days
  AND compaction = {'class': 'TimeWindowCompactionStrategy', 'compaction_window_size': 86400, 'compaction_window_unit': 'SECONDS'};

// Analytics table for KDB+ sync (denormalized for fast queries)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payment_keyspace.analytics (
  date DATE,
  currency TEXT,
  total_amount DECIMAL,
  transaction_count COUNTER,
  avg_amount DECIMAL,
  PRIMARY KEY (date, currency)
) WITH default_time_to_live = 0
  AND compaction = {'class': 'LeveledCompactionStrategy'};

class FraudAutoencoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim):
        super(FraudAutoencoder, self).__init__()
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 16),  # Bottleneck

        self.decoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(16, 32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, input_dim),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        encoded = self.encoder(x)
        decoded = self.decoder(encoded)
        return decoded

            loss.backward()

# Fraud Detection Model (PyTorch Autoencoder for anomaly detection)
class FraudAutoencoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim):
        super(FraudAutoencoder, self).__init__()
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 16),  # Bottleneck
        )
        self.decoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(16, 32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, input_dim),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        encoded = self.encoder(x)
        decoded = self.decoder(encoded)
        return decoded
